purpose: Full-body cosmetic battle skins. Existing portraits remain unchanged. Wands are separate display layers.

characters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a game-ready full-body battle sprite of Mara from the reference portrait. Preserve her red hair, adult freckled face, oxblood robe, leather belt and gold trim exactly. One single figure, full head to boots, three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. Ready dueling stance, feet apart planted at same ground line, knees slightly bent. Right arm extends toward screen right at chest height, right hand is CLOSED as if gripping a small wand, but do NOT draw any wand or magic; the game draws the wand separately. Left hand near waist. Detailed realistic painterly fantasy art, natural adult anatomy, cool rim light. Square canvas, figure fully inside with generous margin, head near 10% canvas height and feet near 92%. Right closed fist near 78% canvas width, 37% height. Transparent background with actual alpha=0 outside silhouette. Absolutely no gradient, smoke, scenery, floor, shadow, glow, backdrop, border, text or other character. Complete boots and coat hem, no crop.

Match image 2's ready stance, extended right arm and CLOSED fist, empty wand grip, left hand by waist, complete head-to-boots framing and square transparent canvas. Face and body turn toward screen RIGHT, feet planted apart. No wand: game draws wand separately. Preserve the identity and colors from image 1, never Mara's identity.
